title: Volvo FM FUPS Hi-tensile Road Train Bullbar #24
description: Volvo heavy duty FUPS high tensile road train aluminium Bullbar. Custom built with heavy duty mesh and additional centre mounted small uprights for maximum cab protection. Custom driving light mounts can be fitted to customer specification. heavy duty aluminium backing plate with tow provision for factory fitted radar. Flip over aluminium Road Train signs. Indicator repeater and daylight running lights fitted to outer boxed uprights. Custom driving light mounts to customer requirements and Safety Sign on upright mounted plate.
